videos.title: The Last Bus to Black Hollow — A Horror Story
videos.description:
Every night, Marcus Cole drives the last bus out of Harlow Creek. Route Nine. But some passengers were never meant to reach their stop...

An original horror story from Midnight Dread Tales. New nightmares every night — subscribe if you dare.

This is an original work of fiction. All characters, places, and events are imagined. This video was created with the assistance of AI tools (voiceover, illustrations).
